title: Relevance AI alternatives for people who do not build agents
h1: relevance ai alternatives for a smaller job
description: Compare Relevance AI with Metal, including the conflicting pricing pages, workforce setup and when a smaller team of bots fits better.
answer: **need a sales deployment, or just help with tomorrow's handoff?** relevance ai builds business agent teams for sales and operations. dusk lets you name a bot and give it that smaller job in plain words. as of 12 november 2026, relevance ai's marketing and docs disagree on plans. get an offer you can buy before budgeting around either price.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: a workforce, or a few focused bots.

them: **you are planning a business deployment.** you want to work with its sales and deployment team.
**its app catalogue matters.** you need the native and pipedream connections it lists.
**you want workforces.** its offer includes unlimited workforces and curated multi-agent systems.
dusk: **your first job is small.** name a bot and describe what it should do.
**you want separate memories.** decide which bots learn from group conversations.
**you want to try personal work locally.** choose hosting later if you need it.

method:
**use the offer to choose a trial, then judge the work.** Metal is based on Dusk Bot. we compared relevance ai's own pages on 12 november 2026.

its pages disagree about plans. we show both. we did not run matching jobs or test a deployment with its sales team.

sections.md:
**get the plan and billing period in writing.** as of 12 november 2026, marketing lists enterprise at a custom price through sales.[^2] the docs still list these prices:[^3]

- pro: $19/month billed annually, or $29 monthly
- team: $234/month billed annually, or $349 monthly
- free: retired for new and existing accounts

ask which plans a new account can buy, which billing period applies and what it includes. don't build your budget around an unresolved offer.

**there are two usage meters too.** pro's listed allowances are 2,500 actions and 10,000 vendor credits. extra usage costs $80 per 1,000 actions and $20 per 10,000 vendor credits.[^3] ask about both; neither number means completed jobs.

sections.h: start with one handoff you can judge
sections.md:
**start with the handoff that keeps falling through.** relevance ai offers business workforces and curated multi-agent systems.[^1][^2] that can fit an organisation planning a deployment.

for a smaller trial, attach sales handoff notes to dusk. ask it to separate confirmed commitments from unanswered questions. keep each source filename beside the finding and leave the originals alone.[^9]

need more viewpoints? [ai teammates](/ai-teammates) explains the setup. a dusk group can have a leader handing out tasks. each bot keeps its own ai and permissions. group learning stays off unless you enable it.[^10][^11]

sections.h: give the first bot one useful job
sections.md:
**a good first brief ends with a decision you can make.** a [founder](/for/founders) can start with sales handoff notes and a list of unanswered questions. attach the files the bot needs.

keep app reviews read only. if you later allow edits, write "ask me before you change anything". dusk can restrict access per bot.[^9][^12]

need a building platform for business workflows? compare [gumloop](/alternatives/gumloop). read current ai provider terms before signing in. this comparison measures neither safety nor accuracy.

faq.q: what is the current relevance ai price?
faq.a: **its own pages disagree.** as of 12 november 2026, marketing lists custom enterprise pricing; docs list pro and team. ask sales which prices a new account can buy.[^2][^3]

faq.q: can non-technical business owners use an agent team?
faq.a: **start with a handoff you already understand.** relevance ai offers deployment help through sales.[^2] dusk lets you make bots and groups in an app.[^6][^10] neither can rescue an unclear brief.

faq.q: can i bring my own model credentials to relevance ai?
faq.a: **yes, its plan docs allow your own api keys.** vendor credits cover model and tool costs otherwise. that doesn't resolve which paid plan a new buyer can get.[^4]

list only the files and apps it needs

mistakes.fix: ask what uses each allowance and what extra usage costs.

mistakes.fix: start with only the sources the first job needs.
